name: Socials
description: Description Socials is a single-page website that stores all your social media and personal websites to share. It is similar to tappy.tech, sociallinks.co, compiled.social and linktr.ee, but open-source and built on Next.js. Your url is http://exemple.com/(user) where [code]user.json[/code] is the file containing the info OR you can create a [code]default.json[/code]. There is mine running at [a href="https://socials.dkil.ca/"]socials.dkil.ca[/a] Configuration /app/people This is where the json files containing someone's socials will be stored. You can see the layout and info on Github.
